sources.prompt: Use case: game UI sprite, isolated blank prop for production. The provided screenshot is only an art direction reference, specifically the matte cyan cloth and warm parchment tally board on the right. Create a NEW standalone much WIDER landscape season standings ledger board on a truly transparent canvas, no scene, no other objects outside the board, front elevation, orthographic with perfectly rectangular usable inset regions, 7:4 approximate silhouette, object fills 96% of canvas width/height, four straight edges. This is the single large panel background in a hand-painted Gothic fantasy game. Its leftmost 28 percent is an uninterrupted dark desaturated petrol teal book cloth surface, flat matte, reading surface for overlaid ivory text from top to bottom. Area right of exactly 29% of object width is a single very light warm ivory parchment sheet, flat and blank, large and uninterrupted from the top right to bottom right, clean smooth evenly lit reading field, quite bright like reference. A narrow subtle shadow at the gutter separates paper and matte dark cloth. Same level from top edge to bottom edge, no inner horizontal boundaries, no turned corners extending into content. Build tactile depth using the dark blue green compressed cloth texture, fine scratches near the very outside, softly irregular paper edges inside the dark backing, very restrained light from upper left, matte gouache painting with clear crisp outlines. Minimal actual hardware: a small deeply toned metal clip close to the top edge of the gutter, out of the reading area, optional subtle small lower right curled paper tip confined to the outermost 1% of width. No writing, letters, markings, icons, badges, decorative stamps, banners, logos, headings, faux text, tables, rows, buttons, and absolutely no clocks, dials, watches, hourglasses, gears, embers, ash, thin brass perimeter, shiny gold frame, or repeated rivets. Treat the screenshot only as reference, generate isolated new panel, shown straight from front on real alpha transparency. Landscape output.

Use case: production hand-painted transparent GAME UI sprite atlas. Create two separate matching game UI signing plaques for the season leaderboard of a Gothic fantasy riverside gatehouse adventure. Screenshot reference is only for the restrained painterly watercolour-gouache style of the paper ticket and old dyed cloth surfaces, do not reproduce the screenshot. Isolated on genuine transparency, two horizontal objects stacked well apart, no touching, bounding boxes fully inside canvas with ample transparent gutters. TOP OBJECT is a 2.2:1 broad, low, dark petrol teal blue matte cloth bound rectangular travel tally plaque, left 27 percent carries ONE clearly recognizable large pressed ivory-paper rank rosette with dull old brass central four-point heraldic mark and a tiny russet dangling ribbon, right 73 percent is calm empty dark matte cloth for 3 lines of ivory game copy. Top plaque with subtly uneven fabric corners, trapezoid bevel at the right edge, very clean negative space. BOTTOM OBJECT is a very wide low matching dark petrol teal cloth mounted tag, width to height exactly 4.1:1, with the SAME small simplified ivory rosette at its far left in the first 18 percent, right 82 percent uninterrupted dark cloth for one line of game text. Keep the shape of both ornaments legible at 25px. Front-on orthographic, no tilt, no foreshortening, no separate cast shadow outside the prop. Art is painted opaque matte rather than metallic sheen. Include no text, words, letters, numbers, UI glyphs or watermarks. Avoid outline metal trim, shiny gold border, repeated rivets, clock or dial imagery, tick marks, hourglass, gears, glowing ash or embers. Place both objects horizontally centered in separate top and bottom halves on alpha, square or landscape canvas.

A single isolated compact blank GAME UI plaque, rendered with subtly textured matte dark petrol blue cloth and the same ivory pleated award ribbon rosette from the example. It displays a season rank under a title, so make it nearly SQUARE compared to the reference tag. CRITICAL the visible plaque (its filled silhouette bounding rectangle, width divided by height) measures exactly 2.15:1. Reference image shows a pair of very long thin tags, disregard their proportions completely. Design this new object like a 156 pixel wide by 72 pixel tall mini award board with three full lines of blank text space. Place the object centered inside an approximately 3:2 frame with transparent top and bottom margins. The ivory award rosette with red ribbon tails itself is taller than half the plaque height, centered vertically, occupies leftmost quarter of the board, very sharp and recognizable at 40 displayed pixels. Keep entirely blank, dark, evenly lit interior from 29% through 93% width, with three lines of whitespace for typography later. Subtly curved cloth lip at bottom and upper left. Strong outlined silhouette front elevation with no perspective. No writing, number, divider, watermark, no metal edging or corner rivets, no dials or mechanical markings. The plaque itself should be about as tall as TWO of the reference's top strip stacked, filling the frame width with breathing room. Output a single sprite with clean genuine alpha, matte gouache and dark blue-green fabric matching reference.
